observations: Three photos show two identical car headlight assemblies lying on a concrete floor.
Each headlight has a clear lens, a circular main bulb housing, and an amber turn signal section on the lower left.
The housing is black plastic with a red trim strip along the top edge.
The design is consistent across all three photos, suggesting they are the same unit.
No visible brand or model markings are readable on the headlight assemblies themselves.
The watermark 'LINUS AUTO - LIGHT SOLUTION' is present on all photos.
The environment appears to be a workshop or storage area with concrete and plastic sheeting in the background.

claims.claim: Contact us for your Honda front and back lights all models available
claims.evidence: The photos show only front headlights; no back lights are visible. The claim about Honda is not supported by the photos, which show no visible Honda branding or model-specific features.

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy. No crack, all clips and brackets complete.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The headlight assemblies may be damaged or non-functional (e.g., cracked lens, broken bulb housing, or missing components).
risks.proof: A close-up shot of the lens and bulb housing showing no cracks, scratches, or broken parts, and a view of the internal bulb and wiring harness.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially non-functional or damaged

risks.risk: The headlight assemblies may not be compatible with the buyer's vehicle model or make.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the part number or model label on the back of the headlight assembly, or a photo showing the headlight installed on a vehicle with visible model/year markings.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic or unverified fit

risks.risk: The headlight assemblies may be counterfeit or low-quality knock-offs.
risks.proof: A close-up of the part number or manufacturer label, or a photo showing the headlight installed on a vehicle with visible OEM branding.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic or unverified quality

proof_requests: A close-up photo of the back of the headlight assembly showing any part numbers or model labels.
A photo of the headlight installed on a vehicle to confirm compatibility.
A close-up of the lens and bulb housing to check for damage or cracks.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
